## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: distraction, road rage, fatigue, health, impairment, external passengers and equipment failures
Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec10-F01 onward) from physical pages 88 to 95; part C2 holds 15 confusable and continuation blocks (sec10-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 - 2027 manual, the 35-question count and the 28-of-35 passing standard from physical page 10; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- OR-RISK-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- OR-RISK-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- OR-RISK-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: none in these pages; the age, blood alcohol and sound distance values (for example sec10-F03, sec10-F23, sec10-F29) are fixed statements of the current manual.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
